name: Sweet Pleasure
source:
Main character is a famous special coach. One day he receives a request for guidance from a famous private girls' school, and knowing the beauty of its students he can not say "no".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位著名的特种教练。有一天，他收到一所著名私立女子学校的指导请求，了解该校学生的美丽，他无法拒绝。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
